records.subject: Concern over status of implementation of Bodoland Peace Accord 2020.
records.SM_Text:
Shri Pramod Boro:

The Bodoland Territorial Region (BTR) has witnessed a remarkable transformation since the signing of the Bodo Peace Accord 2020, which has played a vital role in restoring peace, stability, and democratic governance in the region after decades of unrest. The Accord has created an enabling environment for development, strengthened the democratic aspirations of the people, and fostered greater trust among stakeholders. Considerable progress has been achieved in infrastructure development, education, livelihood generation, and institutional strengthening, reflecting the positive impact of the Accord. However, despite these achievements, several important commitments envisaged under the Accord remain pending. These include constitutional, administrative, financial, developmental, rehabilitation, and institutional provisions that are crucial for the complete realization of its objectives. The timely implementation of these commitments is essential to uphold the assurances extended by the Government, sustain public confidence, reinforce the peace process, promote inclusive development, and ensure long-term socio-economic progress across the region. In view of the above, I request the Government to provide a comprehensive update on the measures taken to fulfil its various provisions. I also urge the Government to expedite the implementation of all pending commitments in a time-bound manner. Such action will reinforce the spirit and intent of this historic Accord, consolidate the gains of peace, and fulfil the long-cherished aspirations of the people of the Bodoland Territorial Region.

(ENDS)

records.subject: ELEVATED OVERBRIDGE FOR WILDLIFE MOVEMENT ON NH 127C
records.extent:
The Consultant for preparation of Detailed Project Report 
(DPR) has been engaged to examine the project alignment with reference to the Eco Sensitive 
Zone and requirement of wildlife crossings. Further action, as required, shall be taken based on 
the outcome of the DPR and the applicable statutory requirements.

records.subject: ELECTRICITY DEMAND IN NORTH EASTERN REGION
records.extent:
(d): 
In the North Eastern Region (including Assam), six Hydroelectric Power Projects (HEPs), 
with a combined installed capacity of 2,166 MW, are currently under implementation and are 
scheduled to be commissioned on or before 31 December 2030.
